## mcloud apps create

Register an app: its namespace, quota and deploys from its repo.

Register an app on maxcloud. This adds the app's entry to the registry in
the cluster (with your kubeconfig, no commit anywhere), and the registry then
creates the app's namespace with its quota and guardrails, its buckets and
database, and starts deploying the app's manifests from its repo.

In an app's repo, mcloud deploy does this by itself from maxcloud.yaml.

The name becomes the namespace, and public services get
https://&lt;service&gt;-&lt;name&gt;.gronblom.dev.

```
mcloud apps create NAME [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud apps create shop --repo maxemiliang/shop
mcloud apps create shop --repo maxemiliang/shop --cpu 500m --memory 2Gi --db
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--branch` string |  | branch to deploy (default main) |
| `--buckets` string |  | S3 buckets, comma-separated; name:public for one anyone can read (uploads,assets:public). Removing one from the list keeps its objects |
| `--cpu` string |  | quota: CPU the app's pods may request in total (default 200m) |
| `--db` string |  | a Postgres database run by the maxcloud controller, backed up and restored by itself (--db, or --db=false to remove it: its backups are kept) |
| `--db-instances` string |  | database instances: 1 (default), or 2 for a replica on the other node |
| `--db-size` string |  | database disk per instance (default 1Gi; can grow, not shrink) |
| `--deploy` string |  | gitops (default: Flux applies the app's manifests from git) or direct (mcloud deploy applies them) |
| `--domains` string |  | custom hostnames, comma-separated &lt;host&gt;:&lt;service&gt;\[:proxied\] (paja.lankkupelit.fi:web:proxied); only those an admin allowed the app |
| `--dry-run` |  | show the change, make none |
| `--memory` string |  | quota: memory the app's pods may request in total (default 1Gi) |
| `--path` string |  | directory of the app's manifests in that repo (default deploy/k8s) |
| `--pods` string |  | quota: number of pods (default 20) |
| `--repo` string |  | the app's GitHub repo, &lt;owner&gt;/&lt;repo&gt;; leave out for an app kept in the registry repo |
| `--timeout` duration | `5m0s` | how long --wait waits |
| `--wait` |  | then wait until the app's deploy has applied |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | don't ask before changing the registry |

## mcloud apps delete

Remove an app, its namespace and all its data.

Remove an app from the registry. Flux then deletes everything the
registry made for it, including its namespace, and with it every database and
volume in it. There is no undo; restore a database from its backup if it had
one.

```
mcloud apps delete NAME [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` |  | show the change, make none |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | don't ask before changing the registry |

## mcloud apps list

List registered apps and whether their last deploy applied.

```
mcloud apps list
```

## mcloud apps set

Change a registered app by hand (apps with a maxcloud.yaml: edit that).

Change fields of a registered app. Only the flags you pass change; pass an
empty value (--cpu "") to go back to the default.

An app's maxcloud.yaml owns what it declares (quota, buckets, db,
domains): change those in the file. This refuses them, since the next push would undo them.
Use it for what the file leaves out, for apps without one, and to switch
--deploy between gitops and direct.

```
mcloud apps set NAME [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud apps set shop --cpu 500m --memory 2Gi
mcloud apps set shop --buckets uploads,assets:public
mcloud apps set shop --db --db-size 2Gi
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--branch` string |  | branch to deploy (default main) |
| `--buckets` string |  | S3 buckets, comma-separated; name:public for one anyone can read (uploads,assets:public). Removing one from the list keeps its objects |
| `--cpu` string |  | quota: CPU the app's pods may request in total (default 200m) |
| `--db` string |  | a Postgres database run by the maxcloud controller, backed up and restored by itself (--db, or --db=false to remove it: its backups are kept) |
| `--db-instances` string |  | database instances: 1 (default), or 2 for a replica on the other node |
| `--db-size` string |  | database disk per instance (default 1Gi; can grow, not shrink) |
| `--deploy` string |  | gitops (default: Flux applies the app's manifests from git) or direct (mcloud deploy applies them) |
| `--domains` string |  | custom hostnames, comma-separated &lt;host&gt;:&lt;service&gt;\[:proxied\] (paja.lankkupelit.fi:web:proxied); only those an admin allowed the app |
| `--dry-run` |  | show the change, make none |
| `--memory` string |  | quota: memory the app's pods may request in total (default 1Gi) |
| `--path` string |  | directory of the app's manifests in that repo (default deploy/k8s) |
| `--pods` string |  | quota: number of pods (default 20) |
| `--repo` string |  | the app's GitHub repo, &lt;owner&gt;/&lt;repo&gt;; leave out for an app kept in the registry repo |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | don't ask before changing the registry |
